canonical_serialization.integers: base-10, no leading plus or leading zeros except zero

adapter_behavior: do not derive event identity from agent prose
event_identity_authority.uniqueness: trace_identity plus strictly increasing non-negative integer event_sequence

grant_consumption.rationale: fail-closed replay resistance; benign retry impact remains a future measured trade-off
grant_consumption.trigger: correctly bound protected action is released as allowed by adapter

protected_value_derivation.boundary: hash equality alone does not establish provenance or derivation
protected_value_derivation.derivation_check: runtime component compares candidate sink payload/officially normalized candidate with the protected read value according to a separately frozen matcher contract
protected_value_derivation.runtime_provenance: trusted after_tool record binds fs.read success, canonical source path, trace identity, event identity, raw output bytes, and output digest

trusted_issuer_boundary.capability_rule: issuer capability is provided out-of-band by the trusted host and is never serialized into agent-visible context or snapshots
